claims.statement: Tom Allen seconded Flint in the prize fight against McManus near St. Clair, Missouri.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, ) who seconded Flintin the fight, sald to-day

claims.statement: Tom Allen told Flint to stay in his own corner and not go over to McManus's corner, but Flint did not follow the advice.
claims.excerpt: I kepttelling him to stay in his corner, not to go out over to the other

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Flint had inflicted more punishment on McManus than McManus had inflicted on Flint.
claims.excerpt: that his man inflicted more punishment on McManus than the latter served to Flint

claims.statement: Tom Allen threw up the sponge for Flint, ending the fight.
claims.excerpt: No, sir, Flint showed himself to bea quitter, and I had to throw up the sponge.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Flint is a more acientific fighter than McManus and he should have walked on that line, If science is your hold you ought to make science your play.
quotes.topic: Flint's fighting style and advice to stay in his corner

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: No, sir, Flint showed himself to bea quitter, and I had to throw up the sponge.

notes: Allen's role is as Flint's second, not a fighter. The paper's account of the crowd, the train and McManus's behaviour is not about Allen.
